Hi Jules / Marissa — thanks for the ping. Below are our formal responses you can include in the questionnaire and draft SLA. I kept language concise so legal can paste directly: 

1) SOC 2 status:
- Current: SOC 2 Type I + ongoing internal controls aligned to Type II.
- Roadmap: Type II assessment in progress; anticipated attestation date: 2027-08-15. We will provide interim evidence (control reports) and a SOC 2 readiness summary attached (Redwood_SOC2-Status-2027Q2.pdf).

2) Data deletion SLA (user data):
- Standard: Redwood processes verified deletion requests within 30 calendar days. Deletion flow: mark-for-delete in primary store -> purge scheduled jobs -> KV cache invalidation -> deletion from backups per backup retention policy.
- Proof: We provide deletion logs and audit trail on request for compliance reviews.

3) Log retention:
- Default: access and audit logs retained for 180 days.
- Options: can extend to 365 days on request (pricing/contract dependent). For customers that require shorter retention, we can work down to 90 days with an enterprise contract amendment.

4) Backups:
- Default retention: 365 days.
- Shorter retention: can be contracted to 90 days for enterprise customers; note that shortening backup retention may affect the window for certain disaster recovery restores — we will document RTO/RPO impact in the SLA.

5) HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads. We will sign a standard BAA and require certain deployment configurations (private VPC, customer-managed keys or approved KMS integration, logging enabled).

6) Contract language (suggested snippet for deletion/backups):
"Redwood will process verified data deletion requests (for purging customer-provided personal data) within 30 calendar days of request. Logs will be retained for a default period of 180 days. Backups will be retained for a default period of 365 days unless otherwise agreed in writing; customers may elect a contracted backup retention period as low as 90 days. Any reduction in backup retention may affect restore windows and is subject to agreement on RTO/RPO parameters."

7) Attachments included: Redwood_Data_Retention_SLA_Draft.pdf (draft SLA language), Redwood_SOC2-Status-2027Q2.pdf, Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (completed sections).

Happy to hop on the call to walk through specifics and to confirm any amendments.

-Neha
